ssh-terrapin.why: OpenSSH 9.3p2 (built before the Dec 2023 fix): offers chacha20-poly1305 without kex-strict, so Terrapin applies. Stock algorithms only: nothing on the broken list.

ssh-current.why: OpenSSH 10.3 advertises kex-strict-s-v00@openssh.com: Terrapin does not apply, and stock algorithms must not read as High. Its banner omits the portable suffix (OpenSSH_10.3), which must still read as 10.3p1: no CVE.

eol-ubuntu1604.why: Ubuntu 16.04 (standard support ended April 2021), named by the SSH banner. An Ubuntu build backports fixes, so its banner version must not produce customer CVE findings.

supported-debian12.why: Debian 12 is supported. Its banner carries the package revision, so CVEs are judged on the exact package: a current package must not show regreSSHion or Terrapin.

tls-weak.why: TLS 1.0/1.1 enabled, 3DES offered, 1024-bit RSA, certificate expired 30 days ago, self-signed.

known_gaps.POSTURE-TLS-WEAK-CIPHER: agent: the TLS scanner records only the server's preferred cipher per version, so 3DES offered beside a stronger preferred suite is never seen (no cipher enumeration). The manager rule is proven by tls-anon.

tls-anon.why: TLS 1.2 whose only cipher is anonymous ECDH, AECDH-AES256-SHA (no server authentication): proves the manager's weak-cipher rule end to end.

tls-strong.why: TLS 1.2/1.3 only, ECDHE with AEAD ciphers, 2048-bit, in date. Self-signed is the one true finding.

redis-noauth.why: Redis 7.2 with protected mode off and no password: anyone on the segment can read and write it. Redis 7.2.16 is a current 7.2 release: CVEs fixed only on the 8.0 line are not evidence against it (product presence, not findings).

redis-auth.why: Redis 7.2 with requirepass: reachable (an exposure finding is fair) but not unauthenticated.

mariadb.why: MariaDB 10.11 with a root password: reachable database, password required. The official image ships without TLS configured. 10.11.19 is current on the 10.11 LTS line; the wire version's 5.5.5- prefix must not be read as the version.

postgres.why: PostgreSQL 16 with a password: reachable database, password required.
